newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Olympia Industries to buy land.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Olympia Industries to buy land.

text.p: Olympia Industries Bhd said on Friday that it has entered into an agreement to buy a piece of freehold land from a MBf Land Bhd unit for 17.09 million ringgit.
In a statement, Olympia said the land measuring 77,677 sq feet in Kuala Lumpur is to be purchased from Mawar Tiara Sdn Bhd and will be used for Olympia's development of a modern township.

Olympia also said it requests a continued suspension in the trading of its shares "pending further announcements to be made". It did not elaborate. Olympia's stock last traded at 2.45 ringgit on January 24.
The purchase price for the land will be satisfied by an issue of 7.99 million new shares at an issue price of 2.14 ringgit per share.

Meanwhile, the stock of MBf Land, which was formerly known as Sri Hartamas Corp Bhd, was suspended on Friday. An official at the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange said the suspension was related to the news about the land sale.
MBf Land stock eased one cent to 1.97 ringgit on Friday prior to the suspension.
